product_summary: Rachna Enterprise, Udyog Nagar, Jamnagar (Gujarat) — 'Brass City'. Self-described as manufacturer and exporter of micro/precision turned brass components, established 1981, ISO 9001:2008. Real catalogue lines (exportersindia.com/rachna-enterprise): brass electrical pins (free-cutting brass IS 319 Type I / BS 249 Type I), brass anchors, brass threaded inserts for plastics (3/4 inch, mixer-grinder/injection-moulding/PPR-CPVC), brass neutral links/bars for panel boards, brass switchgear components (changeover), copper-brass line taps, brass spacers (round & hex, PCB), PCB connector blocks, brass HRC fuse contacts (16–500 A), brass hose, brass earthing & wiring accessories, fasteners, sheet-metal components; cable glands: marine cable gland (brass, nickel-plated, 3/8"–3", ISO metric/NPT/NPS/BSP/BSPT/PG, IP54/IP66), TRS cable gland (16–32 mm), wiping cable gland (BS 6121 Part I 1989), aluminium cable gland (M20–M63).
role_hint: manufacturer (self-declared 'Manufacturer and Exporter'; note the same listing also shows 'Primary Business: Retailer' and turnover Rs. 0.5–2.5 Cr — inconsistent self-classification, possible trader/re-packer element; no customs line available to confirm either way)
comment: HS mapping vs declared codes. 741533 (copper screws/bolts/nuts — actually 7415.33 covers screws, bolts and nuts of copper) — PARTIAL/CORRECT: brass inserts, brass electrical pins, brass spacers, brass fasteners, brass anchors are turned/threaded brass articles and fit 7415.33; however many of these are better classified as 7415.39 (other threaded copper articles) or 7419.20/7419.99 (other copper articles) depending on whether they are threaded. Recommend 741533 + 741539 + 741920. 830241 (base-metal mountings/fittings for buildings) — WRONG for this product mix: the company makes no builders' hardware; cable glands and earthing accessories are electrical installation fittings, not building mountings. Cable glands (marine/TRS/wiping/aluminium) belong in 8536.90 (electrical apparatus for switching/protecting/connecting circuits, incl. glands and connections) or, for the aluminium ones, 7616.99 (other aluminium articles). Brass neutral links, switchgear components, HRC fuse contacts, PCB connector blocks → 8538.90 (parts for switchgear/control apparatus) or 8536.90; PCB connector blocks may also fall in 8536.69. 846693 (parts of machine-tools of 8461–8465) — WRONG: no machine-tool parts appear anywhere in the catalogue; the closest items are turned components for the automobile/electronics/instrumentation/plastic-moulding sectors, which are not machine-tool parts. This code looks like a template/placeholder error. Industry misclassification: declared industry 'Металлургия и горнодобыча' (metallurgy & mining) is inaccurate — this is a downstream brass/copper precision-turned-components and electrical-accessory manufacturer (electrical/electronics/telecom/automotive/instrumentation supply), not a metallurgy or mining company. Product lines MISSING from the declaration: cable glands (marine, TRS, wiping, aluminium) — a major part of the range; brass neutral links/panel-board bars; HRC fuse contacts; PCB connector blocks; copper-brass line taps; brass hose; earthing & wiring accessories; sheet-metal components. Trader signs: listing shows 'Primary Business: Retailer' alongside 'Manufacturer and Exporter' — mixed signals, but the product descriptions (customer drawings, IS 319 / BS 249 material specs, BS 6121 compliance, in-house turning) are consistent with genuine manufacturing. All product data is from the company's own catalogue page (exportersindia.com/rachna-enterprise) — no customs line was available in this research, therefore every product line is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Per project rule 3, the HS mismatch is NOT grounds for rejection: company is retained, codes corrected to 741533/741539/741920/853690/853890/761699, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. No registry, revenue or shipment-volume research performed (out of scope for this role).
